paragraphs.chinese:
这一集里，全家人因为一次烧烤和一场橄榄球比赛聚到了一起，但卢克和曼尼之间的一次打架，却引出了克莱尔和格洛丽亚之间更大的问题。

故事从卢克和曼尼在学校打架开始。他们一直在互相取笑，最后卢克坐到了曼尼胸口上。

家长们和学校校长见面时，男校长说两个孩子其实都是好孩子，只是如果其中一个孩子“有一点与众不同”，相处起来可能会比较困难。见面结束后，克莱尔抱怨格洛丽亚一定觉得卢克才是那个奇怪的孩子；与此同时，格洛丽亚也在抱怨克莱尔一定觉得曼尼才是那个“与众不同”的孩子。两个人都觉得对方在评判自己的孩子，彼此之间的火药味也越来越重。

当天晚上，全家人还是去了杰和格洛丽亚家。杰只想让所有人安静下来，好好看橄榄球比赛，但菲尔觉得大家应该谈一谈到底发生了什么。

菲尔把大家叫到一起，不过杰很快接过话头，问卢克和曼尼，一家人到底是应该互相踢打，还是应该彼此相爱。两个孩子都回答说当然是彼此相爱，于是杰觉得这件事基本就算解决了。后来两个男孩回来时，显然已经重新玩到了一起。

卢克承认自己取笑了曼尼的口音，曼尼也说自己嘲笑卢克每天都吃同样的午餐。卢克还说，他取笑曼尼是因为曼尼的妈妈以前“挖煤”。曼尼随后告诉格洛丽亚，卢克说她以前是个“coal digger”。

所有人顿时安静下来。菲尔解释说，正确的说法其实是“gold digger”，而卢克说这句话是从克莱尔那里听来的。格洛丽亚这才意识到，克莱尔以前觉得她嫁给杰只是为了钱。她格外受伤，因为她本来就觉得自己和曼尼还没有真正被这个家庭完全接纳。

克莱尔试着解释，那句话是很久以前说的，当时她还不真正了解格洛丽亚。但格洛丽亚上楼去了，拒绝再下来。

菲尔上楼和她谈。他解释说，普里切特一家对自己人非常保护。克莱尔第一次把菲尔带回家时，杰也觉得菲尔配不上自己的女儿。后来，杰慢慢看出菲尔有多爱克莱尔，才真正接受了他。菲尔告诉格洛丽亚，克莱尔也只是需要一点时间。

克莱尔最后上楼，认真向格洛丽亚道歉。她承认，父亲再婚这件事一开始确实让她很难接受，但现在她看得出来，格洛丽亚让杰过得很幸福。格洛丽亚接受了道歉，不过条件是克莱尔必须穿着全套衣服跳进游泳池。

与此同时，米切尔一直在努力学习橄榄球，因为卡梅隆很喜欢这项运动。他对比赛的理解比大家预想得深得多，让所有人都很吃惊，不过他的兴趣并没有持续太久。

克莱尔跳进泳池后，严肃的气氛彻底消失了。格洛丽亚原谅了她，很快，几乎所有人不是主动跳进水里，就是被别人推进了水里。
paragraphs.english:
This episode brings the whole family together for a barbecue and a football game, but a fight between Luke and Manny brings out a much bigger problem between Claire and Gloria.

It starts when Luke and Manny get into a fight at school. They’ve been making fun of each other, and Luke ends up sitting on Manny’s chest.

When their parents meet with the school principal, he says both boys are good kids, but things can be difficult when one child is “a little different.” Afterward, Claire complains that Gloria must think Luke is the weird one. At the same time, Gloria complains that Claire must think Manny is the different one. Both women feel that the other is judging her child, and the tension between them gets worse.

The family still goes to Jay and Gloria’s house that evening. Jay mainly wants everyone to stop talking so he can watch the football game, but Phil thinks they should discuss what happened.

Phil gets everyone together, but Jay quickly asks Luke and Manny whether people in their family kick and punch each other or love each other. Both boys say they love each other, and that’s basically the end of Jay’s discussion. Later, the boys come back clearly getting along again.

Luke admits that he made fun of Manny’s accent, and Manny says he teased Luke about eating the same lunch every day. Luke also says he made fun of Manny because his mother used to dig coal. Manny then tells Gloria that Luke said she was a “coal digger.”

Everyone goes quiet. Phil explains that the expression is actually “gold digger,” and Luke says he heard it from Claire. Gloria realizes that Claire once thought she married Jay for his money. She’s especially hurt because she already feels that she and Manny haven’t been fully accepted by the family.

Claire tries to explain that she said it a long time ago, before she really knew Gloria. But Gloria goes upstairs and refuses to come back down.

Phil talks to her. He explains that the Pritchetts are very protective of their family. When Claire first brought Phil home, Jay didn’t think he was good enough for his daughter either. Over time, Jay saw how much Phil loved Claire and finally accepted him. Phil tells Gloria that Claire just needs time too.

Claire eventually goes upstairs and gives Gloria a real apology. She admits that Jay’s new marriage was difficult for her at first, but she now sees that Gloria makes him happy. Gloria accepts the apology, but only after making Claire jump into the swimming pool with all her clothes on.

Meanwhile, Mitchell has been trying to learn about football because Cameron loves it. He surprises everyone by understanding the game much better than expected, although his interest doesn’t last very long.

Once Claire is in the pool, the serious mood disappears. Gloria forgives her, and soon almost everyone is either jumping or being pushed into the water.
